summary.text: Justin Packard is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Justin Packard advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance table lists a 2024 candidacy for Rockingham 30 that ended in a general election loss.
